reviews.author: Keith Dyke
reviews.text:
A Complete Transformation, Couldn't Be Happier

We hired MHG Contracting to do a full basement finish along with some additional work upstairs, and the results are nothing short of spectacular. Over the course of the project, they transformed an unfinished basement into a fully functional living space that includes an entertainment bar area that overlooks an impressive cinema room, making the whole space ideal for large gatherings like a Super Bowl party or equally perfect for a cozy movie night. The basement also features a dedicated home gym with multi-function LED lighting that transforms any workout into a fully immersive experience, and a luxury bathroom complete with a large-format marble tile steam shower, glass enclosure, and smart fixtures. The quality of finish throughout, from the rustic wood-look LVP flooring to the recessed lighting and custom trim work, is consistently impressive across every room.

What really set MHG apart was their collaborative approach. Rather than just executing a spec, the team actively engaged in design conversations and were genuinely enthusiastic about exploring what was possible. Whether it was bar countertop selections, tile choices, or layout decisions, they brought ideas to the table and were flexible enough to try new things. That kind of creative partnership is rare and made the whole process enjoyable rather than stressful.

Beyond the basement, they also installed dark stained wood beam accents in both the living room and primary bedroom, adding warmth and character that perfectly complement the existing ceilings. In the primary bathroom, they added a matching tower cabinet and mirrors that blend seamlessly with the existing finishes, you'd think it was all done at the same time. That ability to match and extend existing work without it feeling like an afterthought is a real skill, and it shows. I would recommend MHG Contracting without hesitation to anyone looking for a team that combines quality workmanship with genuine care for the homeowner's vision.

reviews.text:
I recently hired MHG Contracting to remodel my bathroom, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From the very beginning, they were professional, responsive, and detail-oriented. They listened carefully to what I wanted, offered helpful suggestions, and kept me in the loop throughout the entire process.

The craftsmanship is top-notch, the tile work is beautiful, the fixtures were installed flawlessly, and everything looks and functions exactly as I hoped. The team was respectful of my home, always cleaned up after themselves, and completed the job within the estimated timeframe and budget.

If you're looking for a reliable, skilled contractor for a bathroom renovation, I highly recommend MHG Contracting. I’ll definitely be using them again for future projects.
